description: What the Kinetica exporter has written to its metric tables: metrics, series, labels and ingest volume.

options.content:
### Inventory
The metrics, series and labels in the metric tables, and the points written. Reads the schema **otel**; for another schema, replace `otel.` in the panel queries.

panels.title: Metrics
panels.description: Every metric, with its number of series and services.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metric_name, metric_type, unit,
       COUNT(*) AS series,
       COUNT(DISTINCT service_name) AS services,
       MIN(first_seen) AS first_seen
FROM otel.metric_series
GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, unit
ORDER BY series DESC, metric_name

panels.title: Series per service
panels.description: Series and metrics of each service (service.name).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') AS service,
       COUNT(*) AS series,
       COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS metric_names
FROM otel.metric_series
GROUP BY COALESCE(service_name, '(none)')
ORDER BY series DESC

panels.title: Label keys
panels.description: Every label key, with the number of series having it: the cardinality to watch.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label, COUNT(*) AS series
FROM UNNEST_JSON_OBJECT(SELECT labels FROM otel.metric_series) t(label, label_value)
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY series DESC, label

panels.title: Points written per minute
panels.description: Rows written to each point table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix)) AS time_unix, 'number' AS point_table, COUNT(*) AS points
FROM otel.metric_number_point
WHERE time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix)
UNION ALL
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix)) AS time_unix, 'histogram' AS point_table, COUNT(*) AS points
FROM otel.metric_histogram_point
WHERE time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix)
UNION ALL
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix)) AS time_unix, 'exp_histogram' AS point_table, COUNT(*) AS points
FROM otel.metric_exp_histogram_point
WHERE time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix)
UNION ALL
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix)) AS time_unix, 'summary' AS point_table, COUNT(*) AS points
FROM otel.metric_summary_point
WHERE time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix)

panels.title: New series per hour
panels.description: Series seen for the first time, per metric type.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(TIME_BUCKET(3600000, first_seen)) AS first_seen, metric_type, COUNT(*) AS new_series
FROM otel.metric_series
WHERE first_seen BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(3600000, first_seen), metric_type
ORDER BY first_seen
